headline: A song with AI-generated vocals by a creator called Meomuru has climbed to third place on South Korea's Melon chart and second place on Genie Music and YouTube Music.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a clear sign of AI music reaching mainstream charts, but it is one song's chart position on one day, in one country.
importance_line: Listeners, singers and music creators now see AI-vocal songs competing with human artists, record labels and streaming services must decide how to label and pay for such music, and the rules on training data and rights have not caught up, though this is one outlet's account of chart positions on one day.
summary: Xportsnews, as adapted by The Korea Times, reports that 'Have You Become the Adult You Dreamed of?' by Meomuru, whose vocals were made with the AI music platform Suno while Meomuru wrote the lyrics and directed the production, ranked third on Melon's TOP100 chart as of Wednesday, 14 Oct 2026, and second on Genie Music and YouTube Music. Many listeners learned only afterwards that the vocals were AI-made, and the report says debate is growing over whether AI music could displace human singers and over training data, rights and credit, which remain unresolved.
notes: Read in full on koreatimes.co.kr (16 Oct 2026). The article states it is from Xportsnews, adapted by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times, so the first reporter is credited as the source and the Korea Times page is the url; Xportsnews's original page was not located. 'As of Wednesday' means 14 Oct 2026. The article also names the AI track 'GG EZ' by M. Sasuke (May) and AI-assisted creator Joseon Hip-hop, not used in the summary.
